look_here_first: Think low spreading grayish subshrub: stems can root at the nodes, leaves carry many small silky leaflets, and flowers are purple-violet.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: stems capable of rooting at nodes

lookalikes.differences: The mat-forming/subshrub habit and silky many-leafleted foliage are stronger field cues than flower color alone.
